concerns.location: tasks.md (whole document) vs constitution.md Principle VII / Data Hygiene
concerns.text: Constitution requires every raw Landsat scene checksummed and recorded in the state YAML artifact_hashes map, and every file under data/ checksummed. No task (T001/T002/T005) implements checksumming or hash recording; plan.md's Constitution Check marks Principle VII PASS but the task list silently drops the constraint.

T006 permits verifying SC-002 convergence 'on the actual processed dataset (or a 10-pair subset)'. SC-002 requires convergence for ≥90% of test cases; allowing a 10-pair subset is a retroactive narrowing of the criterion unless the spec defines the population. Remove the subset option or define the population explicitly.

FR-006 requires the final JSON report to contain confidence intervals, and T008's verification claims Pydantic validation against output.schema.yaml — but the FinalReport contract defines regression_coefficients as a bare dict with no CI field. T008 tags itself [FR-006] while its deliverable cannot validate the CI requirement; the contract must be extended or the task will silently fall short.

All tasks reference 'specs/001-ecotourism-regeneration/...' but the contracts actually live under 'specs/001-investigating-the-potential-benefits-of/contracts/'. T002's verification depends on validating against 'specs/.../contracts/timeseries.schema.yaml' — an implementer following the task paths will not find the schema, so SC-003 validation cannot execute as specified. Reconcile the canonical directory.

SC-003 lists 'year' as a critical no-null field, but the timeseries contract's TimeSeriesPoint defines 'date' (no 'year'). T002 enforces 'no nulls in critical fields per SC-003' against a schema whose fields don't match the criterion's naming — align SC-003 or the task's field list so the no-null check is well-defined.

concerns.location: tasks.md:T001 Verification vs plan.md Project Structure
concerns.text: T001 writes site metadata to data/raw/site_coordinates.csv while plan.md's structure lists data/processed/site_metadata.csv. Two conflicting owners/paths for the same artifact; pick one canonical location so downstream tasks (T002 consumes 'site coordinates from T001') are unambiguous.
